description: Structured examples of how the AI should recommend styles based on client profiles.

examples.recommendation: For an Owambe with a ₦45,000 budget, I recommend a beautiful Fit-and-Flare Peplum top with a matching wrapper or skirt using Ankara or simple Lace. Since you have a pear shape, the peplum will perfectly highlight your waist while flowing gracefully over your hips. It's elegant, comfortable, and very budget-friendly.

As the groom, you need to stand out. I highly recommend a full 3-piece Agbada set in premium Aso-Oke or rich Brocade. The broad shoulders and flowing drape of the Agbada are incredibly regal and very flattering for a heavy-set build. We can do extensive hand-embroidery on the chest to give it that true luxury feel.
